verdict.headline: Cryptographically controlled via Ed25519.
statements: Self-certifying: not bound to any origin.

dimensions.label: Document integrity
dimensions.statement: The document is derived deterministically from the identifier itself.
dimensions.proves: The document is exactly what the identifier encodes.

dimensions.label: Key material
dimensions.statement: 1 verification method validated (Ed25519).
dimensions.proves: The published keys are well-formed points usable for their declared relationships.
dimensions.doesNotProve: Who holds the corresponding private keys.

dimensions.label: Update authority
dimensions.statement: Controlled solely by the holder of the Ed25519 private key; the identifier cannot be updated or deactivated.
dimensions.proves: Control is bound to one key by construction.
dimensions.doesNotProve: That the key has not been compromised (did:key cannot rotate).

dimensions.label: Origin binding
dimensions.statement: did:key is not bound to a web origin.

dimensions.label: Transport security
dimensions.statement: No network retrieval was needed.

dimensions.label: Verifiable history
dimensions.statement: The identifier is immutable; there is no history.

dimensions.label: Real-world identity
dimensions.statement: Organization not established. DID.is does not verify legal identity or ownership claims.

verdict.headline: Controlled by the operator of did.is; publishes Ed25519 verification keys.

dimensions.label: Document integrity
dimensions.statement: Retrieved from did.is and its id equals the DID (SHA-256 08a92bc6643f…).
dimensions.proves: This is the document the origin served at resolution time.
dimensions.doesNotProve: That the document was not different before or will not change; did:web keeps no verifiable history.

dimensions.label: Key material
dimensions.statement: 1 verification method validated (Ed25519).
dimensions.proves: The published keys are well-formed points usable for their declared relationships.
dimensions.doesNotProve: Who holds the corresponding private keys.

dimensions.label: Update authority
dimensions.statement: Whoever controls the web server and DNS for did.is can replace this document.
dimensions.proves: Nothing cryptographic: did:web has no signed update mechanism.
dimensions.doesNotProve: That the current keys were authorised by the previous ones.

dimensions.label: Origin binding
dimensions.statement: Origin https://did.is verified via DIF Well-Known DID Configuration.
dimensions.proves: The DID's key signed a statement linking it to this exact origin (bidirectional binding).

dimensions.label: Transport security
dimensions.statement: TLS certificate for did.is issued by Let's Encrypt, valid until 2027-01-01 (82 days).
dimensions.proves: The document came from a server holding a publicly-trusted certificate for the host.
dimensions.doesNotProve: That the server operator is the DID subject.

dimensions.label: Verifiable history
dimensions.statement: did:web keeps no verifiable history; DID.is snapshots are observations, not proofs.
dimensions.doesNotProve: What the document contained before this resolution.

dimensions.label: Real-world identity
dimensions.statement: Organization not established. DID.is does not verify legal identity or ownership claims.

statements: Origin linkage could not be evaluated.
